action.mutates: writes the host-only NIC's link-local address and MAC to /run/p8test-ipv6/linklocal and /run/p8test-ipv6/mac on the node, turns IPv6 forwarding on (net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=1) and adds an on-link route for the documentation prefix 2001:db8:99::/64 on the host-only NIC, until the next revert, so that packets for that prefix are routed through FORWARD (without a route the kernel drops them before FORWARD)

applied.stdout:
icmpv6 dropped
ssh over ipv6 dropped
ssh over ipv4 in

action.mutates: three connection attempts from the peer to the class node (ICMPv6, TCP 22 over IPv6, TCP 22 over IPv4); results in /run/p8test-ipv6/reach.txt on the peer

on the peer: adds a static neighbour entry for the node's link-local address (its MAC handed over, as the class drops neighbour discovery), the unique-local source address fd8e:2b3c:4d5e::24/64 to its host-only NIC (the kernel does not forward packets from a link-local source), a route for 2001:db8:99::/64 via the node's link-local address, and sends 5 pings to 2001:db8:99::1 through it; the ping summary goes to /run/p8test-ipv6/routed.txt

applied.stdout: forward policy counted the routed packets

action.mutates: none beyond reading the chain's policy counters (declared mutating so it runs after the peer sent its packets)
appends `-A INPUT -s fd8e:2b3c:4d5e::99/128 -m comment --comment p8test-rogue6 -j ACCEPT` to ip6tables on the node
none beyond reading the rules (declared mutating so it runs after the node's agent run)
